title: The Shard Foundry

difficulty_contract.damage_rule: No damage may begin in a room transition, mandatory landing, relay interaction, or pickup collection footprint.
difficulty_contract.recovery_rule: Each recovery heart sits after a challenge beat and never on an ordinary room spawn.

zone_plan.purpose: Teach the full movement language, guarantee jet-assist, descend through the Breathing Chamber, and restore the first atmospheric stabilizer.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: One moving bridge followed by the powered freight-lift return.

zone_plan.purpose: Teach the heavy rifle, clear the mandatory Vesperite lock, then require one readable Deepworks recovery.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: A safe rifle acquisition, physical containment obstruction, recurring Sentinel, and one short thermal-vent jump.
zone_plan.recovery: Deepworks is enemy-free and contains the zone's final Signal Shard.

zone_plan.purpose: Test timing on the electrified catwalk, combine one air threat with one ground threat, and restore the second atmospheric stabilizer.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: Electrified-platform timing followed later by separated Ember Wasp, Chitin Sentinel, and Seam Hunter encounters.
zone_plan.recovery: Heart after the electric timing beat; optional Deepworks credit cache before the relay.

zone_plan.purpose: Run a short armored final exam, recover the last Signal Shard, and enter the Uplink Gate.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: Chitin Sentinel, then a spaced arc-leak jump and Pale Watcher guard.
zone_plan.recovery: Heart on the upper route before the final plate.

zone_plan.purpose: Provide a quiet contrast layer with one required signal recovery and one optional economic reward.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: Commit to a one-way drop, then use the guaranteed jet-assist to return.
zone_plan.recovery: No enemies and no contact hazards.

route.objective: Land on Veyra, meet Dras, and reach the Coreworks transport.
Recover equipment and learn the three traversal layers.
Restore two atmospheric relays and reach the upper Uplink route.
systems: switchable telescopic laser seeker and heavy rifle for route clearing, bosses, and heavy combat

route.objective: Recover all twelve Signal Shards, restore both relays, and enter the Uplink Gate.

population.surface_return: Wound-touched Vesperite recovery fades to black and returns Aryn to Veyra with the recovered loadout

encounter_order: Foundry Intake: Chitin Sentinel on the broad ground lane; Squircle Minion visibly circles an upper platform
Breathing Chamber: Core Leech in the air lane, then Chitin Sentinel before the relay apron
Refinery Entry: safe heavy-rifle pickup, Kihunter read, physical obstruction, then Chitin Sentinel
Refinery Exit: Sova and Chitin Sentinel in separate lanes, thermal vent, then enemy-free Deepworks recovery
Biolab Entry: guaranteed Ember Wasp above a ground Chitin Sentinel with no shared mandatory landing
Biolab Relay: Seam Hunter and Chitin Sentinel are separated before a safe relay apron
Deepworks Approach: Skree and Chitin Sentinel are separated before the upper-route recovery heart
Uplink Gate: Seam Lurker above, arc leak on deck, Pale Watcher beyond it, and the final shard at the gate
